title: Feature Request: New SMS command to query IOB separately
body:
Problem:
Currently IOB can only be seen indirectly (e.g. returned with SMS_Bolus by @mushroom-dev ). There is no dedicated SMS command to check IOB directly, like there is for BG.

Proposed feature:
Add a new SMS command (e.g. IOB) that replies with the current IOB value.

Example reply:
IOB: 0.45 U (Basal: 0.20 U, Bolus: 0.25 U)

Benefit:
Allows caregivers and remote users to quickly check IOB without triggering a bolus (eg. via the not yet pulled SMS_Bolus by @mushroom-dev )
